$comment: Manifest for a VFX sub-program. The viewer tool reads these; Blender scripts write them. Adding a new effect = add a new directory with one of these.
name: Fire Shield - Impact
description: The shield absorbs a hit. A flare punches at the contact point, a ripple of bright beads races around the barrier from that point, the flames recoil away from the impact and spring back, and sparks arc off. One-shot; does not loop.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: resolution is the GAMEPLAY cell. Authoring is 512px and pack_sheets downsamples to 128.

layers.note: Small pool that brightens with the hit. Kept small on purpose - at 2.6x it became a second pale egg competing with the flare.
14 cards. Cards near the impact angle are pushed outward, knocked flat and briefly over-bright; the recoil is weighted by angular distance from HIT_ANGLE so the hit reads as directional.
20 beads travelling around the ring from the hit point over frames 2-13, brightest mid-travel.
The contact flash, at HIT_ANGLE (+X). Punched outward over frames 1-3, decayed to nothing by frame 16.
16 particles thrown from the contact point with drag and gravity, staggered delays 2-6.

knownIssues: The hit direction is authored at +X and baked. The game would need a mirrored sheet or a horizontal flip to strike from the left.
Ripple beads travel 0.85 of a full revolution rather than all the way round, so there is a visible seam on the far side.
